ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Administrative Share Creation at Startup
ruleDefinitions.description: Administrative shares are hidden network shares created by Microsoft Windows NT operating systems that grant system administrators remote access to every disk volume on a network-connected system Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Services\\\\LanmanServer\\\\Parameters\\\\.*") AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\AutoShareWks$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\AutoShareServer$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")
